Lively season principles of hand-off notes
This section shows what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk Daily Hand-off Practice

This section keeps hand-offs smooth, caring, and consistent for companion animal travel across Aurelia Skyways. The desk team should leave each shift with clear notes, calm follow-through, and no loose ends that could affect a traveler or pet.

Use plain language in every hand-off note and keep it focused on what the next teammate needs most. Include whether a booking is confirmed, what documents are already checked, and whether any animal needs extra care on arrival. If a traveler has asked for help with a carrier, feeding plan, or check-in support, make sure that request is easy to spot. When a situation changes, update the note before you step away so the next person does not need to guess.

The desk should treat every companion animal case with steady attention and a friendly tone. If Baxter is mentioned in a file, or if Caleb Williams or Leila Okafor calls about a trip, keep the message simple and respectful. Never leave out concerns about behavior, comfort, or paperwork just because the desk is busy. If something is unclear, write that it needs follow-up instead of filling the space with assumptions.

Hand-offs should also show what has already been done, so the next shift can pick up without repeating work. Keep notes neat, current, and easy to read. If a traveler needs a callback, say so in direct words and make sure the request is passed on before the shift ends.

For any case that feels unusual, uncertain, or sensitive, contact the senior coordinator right away.
